title: Cancellation Damages Scale for Group Room Blocks
content:
Each Group Room Blocks type carries a cancellation scale: a ladder of steps, each giving a number of calendar days before arrival ("days from") and a percentage of anticipated room revenue. A step's percentage applies when the cancellation is signed that many calendar days or more before arrival, the first matching step read from the top.

### The scale by block type

| Block type | Step 1 (top) | Step 2 | Step 3 | Step 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 181 days or more: 10% | 91 days or more: 25% | 31 days or more: 50% | 0 days or more: 80% |
| Wedding Room Block | 181 days or more: 25% | 91 days or more: 50% | 31 days or more: 75% | 0 days or more: 100% |
| Sports Team Room Block | 91 days or more: 0% | 31 days or more: 25% | 15 days or more: 50% | 0 days or more: 75% |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 181 days or more: 0% | 61 days or more: 25% | 31 days or more: 50% | 0 days or more: 100% |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 181 days or more: 25% | 91 days or more: 50% | 31 days or more: 75% | 0 days or more: 90% |
| Association Convention Room Block | 366 days or more: 20% | 181 days or more: 40% | 91 days or more: 60% | 0 days or more: 80% |

### Other cancellation terms

| Term | Social Event | Wedding | Sports Team | Tour & Travel | Corporate Meeting | Association Convention |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Damages computed on | contracted room nights times the group rate | same | same | same | same | same |
| Deposits held forfeited toward damages | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Cancellation takes effect only on the organiser's signed notice | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A team eliminated from its tournament may cancel without damages | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |
| Hours after elimination within which notice must be given | 0 | 0 | 24 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The hours column reads 0 where the elimination waiver does not apply.

### Reading the ladder (hypothetical notice dates)

On the Corporate Meeting Room Block scale, a cancellation signed 100 calendar days before arrival does not reach the top step (100 is fewer than 181) and matches step 2 (100 is at least 91): 50%. Signed exactly 91 days before arrival it still matches step 2; signed 90 days before arrival it falls to step 3: 75%.
